author: Thomas Hornor

rights_note: The Met's Open Access images of public-domain works are released CC0. Used only as a reference picture the 1835 merchant is judged against at street distance (T-3449); nothing is traced or sampled from it.
access_notes: Viewed 2026-11-07 (T-3449). Men walking Broadway among women and carts: a man in a blue tailcoat, black top hat and white trousers in the middle of the walk, others in tailcoats and top hats, working men in round jackets and caps. Published 1836, a year after the scene date, and of New York.
note: One of the 1835 merchant reference set's pictures (data/people_match/reference_sets/merchant_1835.json).
what_it_supplies: what a man in a tailcoat and top hat looked like at street distance in an American city of the mid 1830s
what_it_does_not_supply: detail of cut at this size; a hand-coloured print's colours are the colourist's
